input: Find bribery and corruption allegations involving Embraer, in Brazil and abroad

entity.group: Embraer Group; publicly held parent with no controlling shareholder or controlling shareholder group

events.type: Foreign bribery; false accounting — Dominican Republic aircraft sale
events.jurisdiction: Dominican Republic; United States; Brazil
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; its employees and agents; Embraer Representations LLC as payment conduit; a Dominican government official
events.amount: Approximately USD 3.52 million in bribes; approximately USD 96.4 million contract value (as_of: 2016-10-24)
events.summary: Embraer admitted paying a Dominican official through intermediaries to obtain a military-aircraft contract and disguising the payments as sales commissions, including through purported services relating to Jordan.

events.type: Foreign bribery; false accounting — Saudi Arabian aircraft sale
events.jurisdiction: Saudi Arabia; United States; South Africa
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; Embraer executives; Embraer Representations LLC as payment conduit; a Saudi state-owned-company official; a South African intermediary
events.amount: USD 1.65 million in agreed payments; approximately USD 93 million aircraft contract (as_of: 2016-10-24)
events.summary: Embraer admitted routing payments through a sham South African agent to secure an aircraft contract and influence the customer to purchase new rather than used jets.

events.type: Foreign bribery; false accounting — Mozambique aircraft sale
events.jurisdiction: Mozambique; United States
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; its employees and intermediaries; officials associated with Mozambique's state-owned airline
events.summary: The SEC alleged that Embraer paid an intermediary at a Mozambican official's request as a condition of obtaining a state-owned-airline contract and concealed the payments in its accounting.

events.type: Improper intermediary payments; false accounting — Indian military-aircraft sale
events.jurisdiction: India; United States; United Kingdom; Singapore
events.status: settled (U.S. accounting and internal-controls allegations, as_of: 2016-10-24)
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; an Indian consultant; intermediary companies
events.amount: Approximately USD 5.76 million in agent payments; approximately USD 208 million aircraft contract (as_of: 2016-10-24)
events.summary: U.S. authorities alleged that Embraer concealed payments connected with an Indian military-aircraft sale under an unrelated consulting arrangement, with the U.S. India allegations concerning accounting and controls rather than a separately established payment to an Indian official.

events.type: Coordinated FCPA criminal and civil enforcement
events.jurisdiction: United States — Department of Justice and Securities and Exchange Commission
events.status: settled (as_of: 2016-10-24; subsequent criminal dismissal recorded separately)
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; U.S. Department of Justice; Securities and Exchange Commission
events.amount: USD 107,285,090 criminal penalty; USD 83.8 million disgorgement and USD 14.4 million prejudgment interest, with credit for Brazilian disgorgement (as_of: 2016-10-24)
events.summary: Embraer admitted an FCPA conspiracy and inadequate accounting controls, entering a deferred prosecution agreement and parallel SEC settlement covering the overseas schemes rather than additional separate misconduct.

events.type: Brazilian corporate settlement — transnational corruption, money laundering and false accounting
events.jurisdiction: Brazil — Ministério Público Federal and Comissão de Valores Mobiliários
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; Ministério Público Federal; Comissão de Valores Mobiliários
events.amount: BRL 64 million payable to the Fundo de Defesa dos Direitos Difusos (as_of: 2016-10-24)
events.summary: Embraer admitted the conduct described in a Brazilian agreement covering overseas aircraft transactions, undertook extensive cooperation, and obtained commitments limiting corporate civil and administrative proceedings without ending proceedings against individuals.

events.type: Saudi criminal proceedings associated with Embraer's bribery scheme
events.jurisdiction: Saudi Arabia
events.parties: Individuals associated with Embraer S.A.'s Saudi Arabian misconduct; names not supplied in the DOJ release
events.summary: The DOJ reported that Saudi authorities had charged individuals for their alleged involvement in the Embraer aircraft-sale misconduct.

events.type: Indian corruption investigation
events.jurisdiction: India — Central Bureau of Investigation
events.parties: Embraer Brazil; Vipin Khanna; Interdev Pte. Ltd.; unidentified Defence Ministry officials; other alleged participants
events.summary: The CBI registered a corruption case naming Embraer and intermediaries over the military-aircraft procurement, with the involvement of public officials still under investigation in the later court reporting.

events.type: Mozambican exoneration and cooperation agreement
events.jurisdiction: Mozambique
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; Mozambican authorities
events.amount: No financial obligations for Embraer under the agreement (as_of: 2024-12-31)
events.summary: Embraer disclosed an exoneration agreement requiring collaboration with the Mozambican investigation without a financial obligation for the company.

events.type: Bribery-related securities class action
events.jurisdiction: United States — Southern District of New York
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; Frederico Pinheiro Fleury Curado; Jose Antonio de Almeida Filippo; shareholder plaintiffs
events.summary: The court dismissed claims that Embraer and executives inadequately disclosed the scope and financial consequences of the corruption investigations, finding the disclosures sufficient.

events.type: Brazilian administrative enforcement — fiduciary duties and bribery payments
events.jurisdiction: Brazil — Comissão de Valores Mobiliários
events.status: convicted administratively: Orlando José Ferreira Neto; acquitted: Luiz Carlos Siqueira Aguiar (as_of: 2018-09-11)
events.parties: Orlando José Ferreira Neto and Luiz Carlos Siqueira Aguiar, former Embraer S.A. directors
events.amount: USD 3.52 million in underlying payments examined (as_of: 2018-09-11)
events.summary: The CVM disqualified Ferreira Neto from public-company management for five years for his role in circumventing controls to facilitate the Dominican payments, while acquitting Aguiar.

events.type: Dominican corporate bribery conviction and financial sanction
events.jurisdiction: Dominican Republic — Fourth Investigating Court of the National District
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; Dominican Procuraduría General de la República
events.amount: USD 7.04 million payable to the Dominican state (as_of: 2018-09-27)
events.summary: Following Embraer's admission of guilt for bribery connected with the Super Tucano purchase, the Dominican court approved an abbreviated criminal resolution imposing a financial sanction and cooperation obligations.

events.type: Former Embraer executive's foreign-bribery, fraud and money-laundering conviction
events.jurisdiction: United States — Southern District of New York; underlying conduct in Saudi Arabia
events.parties: Colin Steven, former Embraer S.A. executive
events.summary: After pleading guilty over the Saudi aircraft-sale bribery scheme and related offenses, Steven was sentenced to time served, a fine and forfeiture.

events.type: Indian money-laundering prosecution arising from alleged aircraft-deal kickbacks
events.jurisdiction: India — Enforcement Directorate; special PMLA court in New Delhi
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; Interdev Aviation Services Pte Ltd; KRBL Limited; Anoop Kumar Gupta; Anurag Potdar; other defendants
events.amount: USD 5.76 million in alleged kickbacks; approximately USD 3.275 million allegedly routed onward through KRBL DMCC; INR 16.29 crore in assets attached in the case, not identified as Embraer-owned assets (as_of: 2020-12-09)
events.summary: The ED named Embraer in a prosecution complaint alleging that aircraft-deal commissions were routed through sham agreements and intermediary companies to disguise their origin.

events.type: Closure of U.S. corporate FCPA criminal prosecution
events.jurisdiction: United States — Southern District of Florida
events.status: dismissed following deferred prosecution agreement compliance (as_of: 2020-11-30)
events.parties: Embraer S.A.; U.S. Department of Justice
events.summary: The court dismissed the FCPA charges after finding that Embraer had fulfilled its deferred prosecution obligations, following completion of independent compliance monitoring.

events.type: Mozambican convictions concerning proceeds of the Embraer aircraft transaction
events.jurisdiction: Mozambique — Maputo City Court
events.status: convicted: Paulo Zucula and Mateus Zimba; acquitted: José Viegas (as_of: 2021-09-13)
events.parties: Paulo Zucula, former transport minister; Mateus Zimba, intermediary; José Viegas, former LAM chairman; underlying Embraer S.A. transaction
events.amount: USD 430,000 allegedly received by Zucula and USD 370,000 by Zimba; compensation of approximately MZN 40 million and MZN 33 million respectively (as_of: 2021-09-13)
events.summary: The court sentenced Zucula and Zimba to ten years' imprisonment each for laundering proceeds connected with the Embraer purchase while acquitting Viegas, with an appeal opportunity remaining at the reporting date.

events.type: Brazilian administrative proceedings against Embraer's former legal executive
events.jurisdiction: Brazil — Comissão de Valores Mobiliários
events.parties: Flávio Rímoli, Embraer S.A.'s former executive legal vice-president
events.summary: The CVM unanimously acquitted Rímoli of the alleged breach of diligence duties in the international aircraft transaction examined in its corruption-related proceedings.

events.type: Brazilian criminal appeal — Dominican bribery and money laundering
events.jurisdiction: Brazil — Tribunal Regional Federal da 2ª Região
events.status: dismissed as time-barred for specified bribery defendants; acquitted on money laundering; bribery conviction maintained for Eduardo Munhoz de Campos (as_of: 2022-04-28)
events.parties: Former Embraer S.A. executives including Eduardo Munhoz de Campos, Flávio Rímoli, Orlando José Ferreira Neto, Luiz Carlos Siqueira Aguiar and other appellants
events.amount: USD 3.52 million underlying bribery payment examined (as_of: 2022-04-28)
events.summary: The appellate ruling extinguished bribery punishment for eight appellants on limitation grounds and acquitted the appellants of money laundering, while maintaining Campos's bribery conviction with a reduced, noncustodial sentence.

events.type: Indian corruption charges against alleged intermediaries
events.jurisdiction: India — Central Bureau of Investigation
events.parties: Arvind Khanna; Gautam Khaitan; Anup Gupta; underlying Embraer S.A. aircraft transaction
events.summary: The CBI filed a conspiracy and corruption chargesheet against alleged intermediaries in the Embraer transaction, without the report establishing that Embraer itself was included in that chargesheet.

events.type: Closure of Dominican proceedings against alleged bribery recipients
events.jurisdiction: Dominican Republic — Fourth Collegiate Court of the National District
events.status: dismissed through extinction of criminal proceedings (as_of: 2023-09-14)
events.parties: Pedro Rafael Peña Antonio; Carlos Ramón Piccini Núñez; Daniel Aquino Hernández; underlying Embraer S.A. Super Tucano transaction
events.amount: Approximately USD 3.5 million in alleged bribes (as_of: 2023-09-14)
events.summary: The court extinguished proceedings against the named alleged recipients of Embraer payments and ended associated coercive measures, a ruling concerning those defendants rather than a reversal of Embraer's corporate resolution.

output.assessment: Reviewed as_of 2026-11-10: Embraer S.A., the Brazilian listed parent of the Embraer Group, has substantiated historical corruption exposure based on corporate admissions and coordinated settlements; the Brazilian cases identified here concern overseas aircraft transactions rather than a separately verified domestic-bribery scheme. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1355444/000162828026021824/erj-20251231.htm)) The U.S. criminal prosecution was dismissed after compliance with its deferred prosecution agreement, but Embraer's financial statements as_of 2025-12-31 continued to disclose Indian criminal proceedings against the company and ECC Investment Switzerland AG and stated that the potential exposure could not be quantified. ([complianceconcourse.willkie.com](https://complianceconcourse.willkie.com/articles/news-alerts-2020-11-november-20201130-embraer-successfully-completes-dpa/)) A later final Indian disposition, the final outcome of the Saudi individual prosecutions, and subsequent appeals affecting certain individual defendants were not verified in this review.

citations.title: Embraer successfully completes DPA stemming from FCPA charges | Willkie Compliance Concourse

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
